target: S1 fail-closed mechanism: _unwrap_or_default helper + failsoft lint + strata fail-closed routing
findings_summary: Adversarial key-contract audit (2026-06-22) found the dangerous class is `_df.value or {default}` discarding the NOT_AVAILABLE signal -> a FAILED fetch re-stamped AUTHORITATIVE negative. 5 sites: valuation (degrades OK), strata (DANGEROUS - also switches is_apartment template), controls (blank@AUTH), overlays (hazard False@AUTH), sepp (minor). DataField docstring already encodes 3-state semantics; the bug is purely discarding df.confidence. Fix: _unwrap_or_default(df,default)->(value,failed); strata: failed->AMBIGUOUS routing (renovation, no dev claims) + NOT_AVAILABLE card; lint blocks new `_df.value or {` unless annotated failsoft-ok (verified-safe) or failsoft-todo (tracked WO-2/WO-3 for overlays/controls). No DB queries, no schema. Strata fetch is fast/reliable (0.2s) so the conservative renovation-on-failure trade-off is rare.
